MIT, Copyright (c) 2014 Chris Wilson

The original demo auto-inits a Worker from a relative path
(js/metronomeworker.js) and draws a full-window canvas. GifOS inlines
classic scripts into about:srcdoc — that Worker URL has nowhere to go.
The scheduler in app.js is the same lookahead + Web Audio oscillator
click (scheduleAheadTime 0.1s, lookahead 25ms). setTimeout on the main
thread is enough: audible audio prevents timer throttling (Chris notes
this on the README of this commit). Original files are pinned here and
packed inside the GIF.

Tempo and time signature are saved privately. No microphone. Nothing is
fetched. AudioContext-MonkeyPatch and the GitHub ribbon are stripped.
